incidents.name: Harvest Finance fUSDC vault (Curve y pool price manipulation)
incidents.notes: The fUSDC vault priced deposits and withdrawals off the instantaneous share price of the Curve y pool it farmed, so flash-loan swaps that skewed that pool let the attacker mint fUSDC cheaply and redeem it at the restored price; the vault code itself behaved as written.

sources.ref: onchain review: fUSDC vault 0xf0358e8c created 2020-10-19 by 0xf00dd244228f51547f0563e60bca65a30fbf5f7f, not by attack sender 0xf224ab00; the cited tx is one of the ~17 repeated mint/redeem rounds and its logs touch the fUSDC vault (not the fUSDT vault) Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the fUSDC vault is an EIP-1967 proxy; its implementation slot holds 0x9b3be0cc5dd26fd0254088d03d8206792715588b at both the creation block 11086842 and the incident block 11129474, and a binary search of eth_getStorageAt over that range finds no intermediate write (the slot was read directly rather than relying on Upgraded events); the proxy runtime is byte-identical at both blocks and the implementation contains no DELEGATECALL of its own, so the six-and-a-half-day age is measured from the right point.
